description: This file defines the BasicTransitionFragment class, which manages different scene transitions in an Android application. It initializes scenes, handles user interactions via a RadioGroup, and performs various transition effects between scenes.

classes.name: BasicTransitionFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that manages scene transitions with different transition effects, including custom TransitionManagers and dynamic property changes.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, initializes scenes and transition managers, and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: onCheckedChanged
methods.description: Handles user input from the RadioGroup to trigger appropriate scene transitions.
